desc:
🎈 POP. DODGE. SURVIVE!
Jump into fast-paced blowgun battles where your balloons are your lives! Aim carefully, fire your darts, slide past attacks, and pop every enemy balloon before they pop yours.

🏆 Be the best player or team!
🎯 Play Free For All, Team VS Team
⚡ Slide, jump, and use low gravity to outplay opponents
🪙 Earn Tokens from kills, bonuses, tasks, and matches
🎁 Open crates and collect unique blowgun skins
✨ Unlock rare skins with custom VFX and trails
🏹 Practice your aim between rounds
🗺️ Vote for different maps and modes  

🎮 CONTROLS:
Shoot — Left Click / Tap / RT
Aim — Right Click / LT
Slide — C / Mobile Slide Button
  
💡 TIP: Keep moving and use slides to make your balloons harder to hit!

🎁 CURRENT CODE: RELEASE

❤️ Like and favorite the game for more maps, skins, modes, codes, and updates!
